lines.t:
A socket in a <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> where a <c:ffff00>{{medalia}}<c> can be set.

The number of slots depends on <c:ffff00>{{rank}}<c>:
  {{bronze}}: 1, {{silver}}: 2, {{gold}}: 3

If all 3 slots of the {{medal}} hold {{medalia}} of the same
shape, the <c:ffff00>{{leader_effect}}<c> changes; if they are the
same color, a <c:ffff00>{{medal_change}}<c> occurs.
